tasks.description: Move the KUKA attachment site to the specified reachable target and hold.
Trace a 4 cm square in the attachment site's XY plane and return to the start.
Move the KUKA attachment site upward by 5 cm, hold briefly, and return home.
Visit three reachable attachment-site waypoints in order and finish at the final waypoint.
Attempt an unreachable attachment-site target, detect the failed reach, and return home without retrying.
